title: Start Two New Rune Vaults and Keep the Tabs Apart

steps.intent: start a new Claude tab, press New Rune Vault, name it and press Done, then press Start Session without sending a message
in Runes, press Modify, switch one rune's State to Off and press Done
start a second Claude tab the same way, with its own new Rune Vault
in the second tab's Runes, check the rune I switched in the first tab still reads State: On and Lock still reads Lock
go back to the first tab and check its rune still reads State: Off
